podcast.body: This LP was recorded by the Beastie Boys in two days at Studio 171A, which was about to go out of business, with the landlord threatening to sell off gear for back rent. Engineer Scott Jarvis rescued a tape machine and mixed the tracks in his bedroom. It was released on Rat Cage on November 20th, 1982. "The Beastie Boys came out on Rat Cage, and the date was November 20th, 1982."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This LP was recorded in only two days at the 171A studio because the landlord was threatening to sell all the gear to collect back rents. After recording the eight songs, the band broke up again. An engineer, Scott Jarvis, rescued a tape machine and mixed the tracks in his bedroom. It was released on Rat Cage on November 20, 1982. "The result was an LP called Polywag Stew."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
